def_en: 1) to settle down, abide, dwell, tabernacle, reside
1b2) to make or cause to dwell
1c1) to lay, place, set, establish, settle, fix
1c2) to cause to dwell or abide
kjv: abide, continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-er), have habitation, inhabit, lay, place, (cause to) remain, rest, set (up).
expl: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
etim: a primitive root (apparently akin (by transmission) to through the idea of lodging; compare , );
